articles.summary: Western Alliance Bank (NYSE:WAL) has been named Phoenix Business of the Year, the top honor given in the Greater Phoenix Chamber’s Excellence in Business Awards, announced June 9, 2026.
articles.title: Western Alliance Bank Named Phoenix Business of the Year by Greater Phoenix Chamber

articles.summary: Western Alliance Bank (NYSE: WAL) today announced that it has been named to Forbes 2026 America’s Best-in-State Banks List, ranking #1 in Arizona and standing as the only Arizona-based bank included.
articles.title: WA - Named # 1 Best Bank in Arizona on Forbes 2026 Best-In-State Banks List
